3510-4288-4875-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Conspiracy.
3510-4288-4875-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Conspiracy and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Sarinth Greatwurm to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

650-3899-6553.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2438-4275-5003-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
2438-4275-5003-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3682-4574-4659-6769-6842.notablePrerequisites:
There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
3682-4574-4659-6769-6842.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Amber enters, Surge Conductor triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artfacts you control.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mox Amber, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mox Amber from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Mox Amber.
Repeat.

1972-4691-7666.description:
Donate Vilis to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Nekusar triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2112-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2112-2921-6972.notes: If Hound of Griselbrand starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

147-6798-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-6798-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {3}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2079-3259-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
2079-3259-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
2079-3259-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Temur Ascendancy so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

2511-2730-5237.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Renegade Rallier.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Renegade Rallier
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

1323-4687-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other creature
1323-4687-7203.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Brigid's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

538-2034-3490-4369.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
538-2034-3490-4369.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Impact Tremors triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impact Tremors triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Impact Tremors triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

2557-4017-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2557-4017-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

5330-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

539-4050-7035.description:
Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Earthbending Student
When Earthbending Student dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.

2957-3767-3918-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least 3.
2957-3767-3918-4306.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

997-3497-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
997-3497-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
997-3497-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
997-3497-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

198-4067-4477-6281.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Greenwarden of Murasa.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

3719-6323.easyPrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness.
3719-6323.notablePrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
3719-6323.description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Jumbo Cactuar and create 10,000 Treasure tokens.

586-2034-5626-6112.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {C}{C}.
When Priest of Gix dies, Fumulus's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Insect and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

586-5553-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
586-5553-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Priest of Gix and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

148-1029-1506-1742.notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger and Keen Sense attached to Tolarian Kraken.
Tolarian Kraken does not have summoning sickness.
148-1029-1506-1742.description:
Activate Tolarian Kraken by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any opponent.
Keen Sense triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Resolve the Tolarian Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to untap it.
Repeat.

1920-2359-4186.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1920-2359-4186.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Season of Growth's first ability triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

705-1920-3197.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a green creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
705-1920-3197.description:
Cause a green creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Sylvan Anthem triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

722-1618.manaNeeded: {4}{W}{W} the first turn if Chronomantic Escape is in your hand, or {7} available otherwise, with {7} available each following turn
722-1618.notablePrerequisites: Chronomantic Escape in hand or in exile with at least one time counter on it.
722-1618.description:
If Chronomantic Escape is in your hand, cast it by paying {4}{W}{W}.
Otherwise, activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, causing you to time travel three times, removing all time counters from Chronomantic Escape and cast Chronomantic Escape from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape, preventing creatures from attacking you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Espace with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2 during each of your turns.

147-2034-2171.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard.
147-2034-2171.description:
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Persist.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Persist, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Persist copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1636-4000.notablePrerequisites:
Rhys does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G/W}.
1636-4000.description:
Activate any number of mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G/W}.
Activate Rhys' first ability by paying {2}{G/W} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
The Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

719-1636-4117-4338.notablePrerequisites:
Visara does not have summoning sickness.
"Cleric" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1636-4117-4338.description:
Activate Visara by tapping it, destroying any creature you control.
The creature dies, triggering Rotlung Reanimator, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

141-3647.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Displace.
141-3647.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Displace, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Displace, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.
